normative_language.SHOULD: candidate recommendation requiring recorded rationale when not followed

clauses.title: Canonical profile subject
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies one bounded, versioned configuration as its canonical subject.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every ASR-001 profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Findings become misleading when an activity, product, event, company, and deployment are collapsed.
clauses.rationale: Object lock is the precondition for interpreting every other disclosure.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Ambiguity is recorded as unresolved rather than broadened silently.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST identify one bounded, versioned configuration as its canonical subject.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Related-object boundary
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies secondary related objects and states which findings do not transfer to them.
clauses.applicability_condition: Whenever secondary objects, organizations, platforms, activities, or events are referenced.
clauses.problem_addressed: Evidence about one configuration is often generalized to an entire platform or sport.
clauses.rationale: Explicit boundaries prevent scope inflation.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown relationships remain unknown.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST identify secondary related objects and states which findings do not transfer to them.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Operating context
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the deployment context, location, participant setting, temporal state, and intended use.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: The same technical system can operate as contest, training, rehabilitation, research, or entertainment.
clauses.rationale: Context determines applicability and interpretation.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unpublished configuration details are marked not evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST describe the deployment context, location, participant setting, temporal state, and intended use.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: System roles and dependencies
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile lists system roles and material technical, institutional, equipment, and organizational dependencies.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile; empty roles are not permitted.
clauses.problem_addressed: Role and dependency changes can alter the meaning of a profile.
clauses.rationale: Profiles remain configuration-specific only when dependencies are visible.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Dependency availability can be unknown or version-limited.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST list system roles and material technical, institutional, equipment, and organizational dependencies.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Performance window
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile defines the interval during which actions can materially affect the evaluated result or support outcome.
clauses.applicability_condition: Human Performance Agency or performance-dependent result is claimed.
clauses.problem_addressed: Agency cannot be attributed without defining when performance occurs.
clauses.rationale: The performance window separates live performance from prior design or later analysis.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: If the window cannot be bounded, the agency finding remains disputed or unknown.
clauses.normative_text: When human Performance Agency or performance-dependent result is claimed, the profile MUST define the interval during which actions can materially affect the evaluated result or support outcome.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Agency modes and segments
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes active agents, assistance, autonomy, and phase-level handoff when control changes.
clauses.applicability_condition: More than one agency mode exists or control varies by phase or regime.
clauses.problem_addressed: Summary labels conceal human-machine handoff and causal contribution.
clauses.rationale: Agency Segments preserve observed control without pretending to solve causal attribution.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Permitted control modes are not presented as observed transitions without evidence.
clauses.normative_text: When agency modes, control regimes, or handoff are present, the profile MUST describe the active agents, assistance, autonomy, and phase-level transitions. The disclosure MUST distinguish design or preparation agency from in-window performance or autonomous execution.
clauses.change_reason: Agency modes and handoff can exist in autonomous execution without live human Performance Agency.

clauses.title: Performance interface channels
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the channels through which human action or intention enters the system.
clauses.applicability_condition: Human performance is part of the profiled configuration.
clauses.problem_addressed: Interface mediation changes what counts as observable performance and failure.
clauses.rationale: Interface description prevents remote, assisted, tracked, and biological channels from being collapsed.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unclear or proprietary interface behavior is marked not evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: When human performance is part of the profiled configuration, the profile MUST describe the channels through which human action or intention enters the system.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Embodied demand and biological control
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes evidenced bodily, physiological, sensorimotor, cognitive, or adaptive demands without assigning an embodiment score.
clauses.applicability_condition: The profile makes an embodiment, athletic, physiological, or biological-control claim.
clauses.problem_addressed: Visible movement is not the only performance channel, while any biosignal is not automatically athletic embodiment.
clauses.rationale: Channel-based disclosure preserves diversity without inventing a universal threshold.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: BCI and other disputed channels retain unresolved category relation.
clauses.normative_text: When embodied demand or intentional biological control is claimed, the profile MUST describe the evidenced bodily, physiological, sensorimotor, cognitive, or adaptive channels without assigning an embodiment score or resolving disputed athletic membership.
clauses.change_reason: Embodiment or intentional biological control can be disclosed in support or disputed contexts without presuming a settled human-performance classification.

clauses.title: Arena configuration
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes physical, computational, and unified arenas, rule-bearing zones, and tracking volumes relevant to the configuration.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile; non-spatial support contexts can state not applicable for specific arena elements.
clauses.problem_addressed: Physical spatial skill, display mediation, and computationally constituted space are often confused.
clauses.rationale: Arena disclosure anchors Operational Spatial Integration claims.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Absent public technical detail is preserved as not evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST describe physical, computational, and unified arenas, rule-bearing zones, and tracking volumes relevant to the configuration.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Distributed-arena relation
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes topology, shared state, synchronization, sites, remote operators, calibration relation, officiation, and responsibility when distributed operation is claimed.
clauses.applicability_condition: More than one physical site or remote-control relation is material.
clauses.problem_addressed: Remote control, remote synchronous competition, co-location, and remote supervision are different integrity conditions.
clauses.rationale: Explicit topology prevents global availability from being mistaken for remote synchronous integrity.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Technical values remain not evidenced when no authoritative source exists.
clauses.normative_text: When more than one physical site or remote-control relation is material, the profile MUST describe topology, shared state, synchronization, sites, remote operators, calibration relation, officiation, and responsibility when distributed operation is claimed.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Rule and constraint sources
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies the authoritative rules, constraints, versions, and responsible bodies used by the configuration.
clauses.applicability_condition: Rules, eligibility, task constraints, or contest procedures govern the configuration.
clauses.problem_addressed: Declared rules can diverge from the operative software or deployment.
clauses.rationale: Rule provenance supports integrity and correction.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unavailable operative rules are disclosed rather than inferred from marketing.
clauses.normative_text: When rules, eligibility, task constraints, or contest procedures govern the configuration, the profile MUST identify the authoritative rules, constraints, versions, and responsible bodies used by the configuration.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Operative rule execution
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes whether constraints are applied through people, equipment, sensors, geometry, software, or combinations.
clauses.applicability_condition: A rule-bearing or constraint-bearing mechanism exists.
clauses.problem_addressed: Textual rules alone do not reveal how the contest or task actually operates.
clauses.rationale: Implementation disclosure exposes divergence and failure paths.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Opaque code can be recorded as partially evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: When a rule-bearing or constraint-bearing mechanism exists, the profile MUST describe whether constraints are applied through people, equipment, sensors, geometry, software, or combinations.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Observation and estimation boundary
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile distinguishes directly measured state, inferred state, calculated state, and provider-declared state.
clauses.applicability_condition: Sensing, tracking, physiological measurement, or state estimation is used.
clauses.problem_addressed: Inference is frequently presented as direct measurement.
clauses.rationale: The distinction is necessary for interpreting measurement and failure.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Undisclosed algorithms remain not evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: When sensing, tracking, physiological measurement, or state estimation is used, the profile MUST the profile distinguishes directly measured state, inferred state, calculated state, and provider-declared state.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Sensing failure and uncertainty
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes known loss, drift, occlusion, latency, decoder, or state-estimation limitations and their effect on the profile subject.
clauses.applicability_condition: Sensing, tracking, or state estimation is material.
clauses.problem_addressed: Profiles that list sensors without failure behavior overstate certainty.
clauses.rationale: Failure disclosure connects technical conditions to integrity without creating a score.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown failure characteristics remain unknown.
clauses.normative_text: When sensing, tracking, or state estimation is material, the profile MUST describe known loss, drift, occlusion, latency, decoder, or state-estimation limitations and their effect on the profile subject.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Metric and calibration disclosure
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies each material metric, unit, source, calibration basis, uncertainty, and intended use.
clauses.applicability_condition: A metric, measurement, ranking, assessment, or quantitative claim is presented.
clauses.problem_addressed: Identically named metrics can be produced under incompatible conditions.
clauses.rationale: Metric provenance is necessary before comparison.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unavailable calibration information is not converted into zero quality.
clauses.normative_text: When a metric, measurement, ranking, assessment, or quantitative claim is presented, the profile MUST identify each material metric, unit, source, calibration basis, uncertainty, and intended use.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Comparability conditions
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile states the equipment, version, environment, classification, adaptation, network, and procedural conditions under which a comparison is intended.
clauses.applicability_condition: Two or more performances, systems, sessions, or results are compared.
clauses.problem_addressed: Comparability is engineered and object-specific.
clauses.rationale: Explicit conditions prevent unqualified equivalence claims.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Partial comparability remains a valid state.
clauses.normative_text: When two or more performances, systems, sessions, or results are compared, the profile MUST state the equipment, version, environment, classification, adaptation, network, and procedural conditions under which a comparison is intended.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Officiation and decision authority
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies human, automated, operator, and hybrid decision authorities, including correction or appeal paths where they exist.
clauses.applicability_condition: A contest, result, penalty, therapeutic decision, or formal outcome is present.
clauses.problem_addressed: Software decisions and human authority are often conflated.
clauses.rationale: Authority disclosure supports accountability.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: No appeal process is recorded as absent or not evidenced, not invented.
clauses.normative_text: When a contest, result, penalty, therapeutic decision, or formal outcome is present, the profile MUST identify human, automated, operator, and hybrid decision authorities, including correction or appeal paths where they exist.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Outcome and consequence structure
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes the evaluated outcome, openness, ranking or support result, and derived consequence structure.
clauses.applicability_condition: A result or consequential support process exists.
clauses.problem_addressed: Contest consequence and clinical or training consequence are different.
clauses.rationale: Consequence remains descriptive and derived rather than a score.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Non-contest systems can mark outcome openness not applicable.
clauses.normative_text: When a result or consequential support process exists, the profile MUST describe the evaluated outcome, openness, ranking or support result, and derived consequence structure.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Spatial function claims
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies each claimed Operational Spatial Integration function and links it to a mechanism, affected object, evidence, and significance.
clauses.applicability_condition: The profile claims computationally mediated space represents, enables, mediates, constrains, measures, compares, or officiates.
clauses.problem_addressed: Use of XR, 3D, telemetry, or immersion does not establish operational spatial integration by itself.
clauses.rationale: Function-level claims preserve discrimination without a spatiality score.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Disputed or partial functions remain explicit.
clauses.normative_text: When the profile claims computationally mediated space represents, enables, mediates, constrains, measures, compares, or officiates, the profile MUST identify each claimed Operational Spatial Integration function and links it to a mechanism, affected object, evidence, and significance.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Spatial function failure effects
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes how failure or removal of each constitutive or supportive spatial function changes the configured activity or result.
clauses.applicability_condition: An Operational Spatial Integration function is claimed.
clauses.problem_addressed: Feature lists do not show whether the function is incidental, supportive, or constitutive.
clauses.rationale: Failure effects test the operational nature of the claim.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: When failure effects are unknown, the claim remains limited.
clauses.normative_text: When an Operational Spatial Integration function is claimed, the profile MUST describe how failure or removal of each constitutive or supportive spatial function changes the configured activity or result.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Actor-role disclosure
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies performers, coaches, officials, operators, supervisors, spectators, developers, and other material actors.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Actor presence does not establish Performance Agency or authority.
clauses.rationale: Role separation prevents attribution errors.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unclear roles remain unresolved.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST identify performers, coaches, officials, operators, supervisors, spectators, developers, and other material actors.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Participatory actor relation
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile describes external actors who materially alter resources, constraints, information, triggers, or supervision without performing.
clauses.applicability_condition: A non-performing actor materially affects the configured process.
clauses.problem_addressed: Spectator, engineer, or therapist influence can be constitutive without becoming Performance Agency.
clauses.rationale: The relation preserves agency and governance boundaries.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Materiality can remain disputed.
clauses.normative_text: When a non-performing actor materially affects the configured process, the profile MUST describe external actors who materially alter resources, constraints, information, triggers, or supervision without performing.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Safety, accessibility, and human-limit disclosure
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile records known hazards, accessibility conditions, body variation, adaptive equipment, fatigue, collision, cybersickness, cognitive demand, and relevant limitations.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile records applicable disclosures or a justified not-applicable state.
clauses.problem_addressed: Silence about safety or access can be mistaken for absence of risk or universal usability.
clauses.rationale: Disclosure supports responsible interpretation without certifying safety.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown hazards remain unknown and clinical claims retain their evidence class.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST record known hazards, accessibility conditions, body variation, adaptive equipment, fatigue, collision, cybersickness, cognitive demand, and relevant limitations.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Operational responsibility and limitations
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies responsible parties for deployment, safety controls, access decisions, supervision, and known limitation management.
clauses.applicability_condition: Operational responsibility is material to participation or support use.
clauses.problem_addressed: Technical capability descriptions often omit who manages human risk and access.
clauses.rationale: Responsibility disclosure separates documentation from approval.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unassigned responsibility is recorded explicitly.
clauses.normative_text: When operational responsibility is material to participation or support use, the profile MUST identify responsible parties for deployment, safety controls, access decisions, supervision, and known limitation management.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Claim classification and source linkage
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile assigns a claim class and traceable evidence record to each material factual or analytical claim.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every material claim in the profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Provider claims, sourced facts, synthesis, and interpretation are routinely mixed.
clauses.rationale: Claim separation is the core trust function of the profile.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unsupported claims remain attributed or not evidenced.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST assign a claim class and traceable evidence record to each material factual or analytical claim.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Uncertainty and limitation states
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile preserves supported, partial, absent, disputed, unknown, not applicable, and not evidenced states with a stated basis.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Binary completeness encourages false certainty.
clauses.rationale: Uncertainty is a valid output rather than a failed score.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown is never inferred as absence.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST the profile preserves supported, partial, absent, disputed, unknown, not applicable, and not evidenced states with a stated basis.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Governance, version, and responsible authority
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies the responsible profile publisher, system authority, rule or software versions, review date, and material commercial relationships.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Profiles become stale or conflicted when ownership and versions are hidden.
clauses.rationale: Governance metadata supports accountability and independence.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Unknown authority is disclosed.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST identify the responsible profile publisher, system authority, rule or software versions, review date, and material commercial relationships.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Correction and supersession
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile records substantive corrections, affected fields or clauses, reason, evidence, date, and supersession relation.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile supports lifecycle correction, even when no correction has occurred.
clauses.problem_addressed: Silent overwrite destroys the evidence trail.
clauses.rationale: Append-only correction strengthens reference trust.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: No-correction history is distinguishable from unavailable history.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST record substantive corrections, affected fields or clauses, reason, evidence, date, and supersession relation.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Profile identity and metadata
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile has a stable identifier, profile version, creation and revision dates, language, status, subject identifier, and applicable ASR Working Draft version.
clauses.applicability_condition: Every profile.
clauses.problem_addressed: Machine and human consumers cannot reliably compare unidentified profile instances.
clauses.rationale: Stable metadata enables citation, correction, and exchange.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Draft status remains visible.
clauses.normative_text: The profile MUST have a stable identifier, profile version, creation and revision dates, language, status, subject identifier, and applicable ASR Working Draft version.
clauses.change_reason: No clause-level defect found in Sprint 11 trials.

clauses.title: Machine-readable distribution and licensing
clauses.candidate_obligation_intent: The profile identifies machine-readable distributions, serialization version, validation status, license or reuse notice, and extension namespaces when provided.
clauses.applicability_condition: A structured distribution, API, JSON, RDF, CSV, or equivalent is supplied.
clauses.problem_addressed: Structured data can become ambiguous or legally unclear without version and reuse metadata.
clauses.rationale: Distribution metadata supports reliable reuse without converting research licensing into third-party relicensing.
clauses.uncertainty_handling: Absent structured distribution is not a profile-quality score.
clauses.normative_text: When a machine-readable distribution is provided, the profile MUST identify its format, serialization version, validation status, reuse notice, and extension namespaces. A JSON ASR-001 profile instance is itself a machine-readable distribution.
clauses.change_reason: For JSON implementation instances, the machine-readable distribution trigger is structurally present and is enforced by the v0.2 validator.
